system.description: This Charm channels the Dragon-Blood's martial excellence directly into the performance of a warrior acting as a special character in support of a military unit. When the Exalt supplements any personal combat action she undertakes while acting as a special character in mass combat, the successes from that action are doubled for the purpose of determining its contribution to the unit's overall performance that tick — but not for the purpose of inflicting personal damage or winning personal combat. A hero who slays an enemy champion with doubled successes inspires her unit to fight harder, but those doubled successes don't add to raw damage. See also Excellence of the Dutiful Sorcerer for the equivalent effect when performing sorcery or Occult actions in mass combat.
